messages:
marco: Quick heads-up — during a customer debug we couldn't trace which service account actually executed requests when a proxy impersonated. Console shows caller project and it's misleading.
zoe: Do we already capture 'effective identity' anywhere in traces?
anish: Not currently. We only tag meter records with the incoming API key project. That means alerts/buckets point to the proxy owner, not the SA.
claire: That makes triage hard. Customers expect an audit trail: caller -> proxy -> SA. We should surface the final principal.
marco: Implementation idea: auth-proxy emits sealed header `X-RW-Effective-Principal: sa:projects/proj-xyz/serviceAccounts/rt-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com` while keeping `X-RW-Origin: proj:caller-123`. Runtime attaches both to spans/metrics.
zoe: Nice. Minimal example in proxy: ```headers.Set("X-RW-Effective-Principal", effectivePrincipal) // set only after mTLS validation```
anish: Two big risks: metric cardinality (lots of ephemeral SAs) and accidental exposure across orgs in console.
claire: Privacy: console must gate SA links by viewer access. If viewer lacks access, show "service account (hidden)" with a hint and a link to request access.
marco: Cardinality strategy: record `effective_principal` as an optional dimension, but index only top-100 principals per org by count; everything else rolls into `sa:other`. Also emit `impersonation_chain_len` and `impersonation_origin` for debugging.
anish: Good. We'll need a cardinality report before flipping. I'll run a 30d unique SA sample and post counts. If > threshold we keep the rollup approach.
zoe: Billing ETL must remain unchanged. Make sure billing ignores new dimension unless explicitly enabled. Backfill should be read-only: annotate traces, don't alter billed amounts.
claire: Rollout plan: 1) enable header emission behind internal flag for 72h, 2) collect cardinality & trace samples, 3) add console column behind feature flag with access gating, 4) make alerting by effective principal opt-in.
marco: Security: only authenticate proxies can set the header (mTLS + header signature). Reject requests that set it externally. Add validation in runtime.
anish: Observability changes: metrics: `rw.requests.count{origin_project, effective_principal?, model, route}`; traces: add attribute `rw.effective_principal`. We'll measure ingestion cost impact.
zoe: UX: add a toggle in usage table "Group by: origin / effective principal" and a small banner when many principals are grouped: "Some principals aggregated for cardinality".
claire: Edge case: chained impersonation. We will surface only the final effective principal; also store `impersonation_chain_len` and sample the chain for audit logs if chain_len>1.
marco: Action items: Anish run 30d SA-uniqueness sample; Zoe draft UI mocks & privacy copy; Claire draft RFC with rollout steps; Marco prep small PR to add header emission behind flag.
observability-bot: Note: RFC required: "impersonation-audit-trail". Please attach cardinality numbers and estimated metric cost.
marco: Target: flip header flag for internal telemetry by next Wednesday, collect 72h, then reconvene. Ping #eng-oncall immediately if alert noise spikes. :thumbsup:
